mobbin:8faed082-5416-4324-b104-7056f0993.summary: From the More hub the user opens Communicate, is prompted to enable Household Drop In as an intercom, then lands on Communication with separate Drop In and Announce targets.
steps: Household Drop In — Later / Enable modal
steal: Drop In vs Announce as separate top actions (step 3) — live room intercom and one-way broadcast are not the same control.
Enable gate with Later + Enable (step 2) — opt-in before the phone can drop into rooms/devices.
Bullet promise 'See recently active devices' (step 2) — surface which rooms are alive before connecting.
Large Communicate tile among peer jobs on More (step 1) — big-target entry for gloved / one-hand use.
avoid: Promo banner on the Communication hub (step 3) — marketing card competes with the Drop In / Announce targets.
mobbin:8faed082-5416-4324-b104-7056f0993.fit: Mobile beats SRV for phone-as-intercom to a sim room: separate Drop In (live) vs Announce (broadcast) would extend the Baseline intercom mic concept; not a desktop-only job.
